facts.text: Plausible Analytics is an independent, open-source web analytics company based in the European Union.
The company is completely self-funded and operates profitably without outside investors.
Plausible operates with a team of 11 people.
More than 22,000 paying customer subscribers use Plausible.
Plausible self-hosts its ClickHouse database and PostgreSQL instances.
Plausible deploys workloads using Docker on Hetzner Cloud servers running Ubuntu.
Plausible's self-hosted Community Edition is distributed under the AGPLv3 open-source license.
Aggressive ad blockers can block Plausible despite its privacy-friendly model because they target all analytics tools indiscriminately.
Vertically scaling single servers reached operational limits under high-volume event ingestion.
Providing technical support to open-source self-hosters in the same manner as paying subscribers proved impossible to sustain.
Standard Google Analytics remains available without any subscription fee.
